_comment: Candidate context for Lisa. This WHOLE object is sent to the model on every scoring call (as the cached system block), so it is the CANONICAL candidate context: the model has no other view of her career — Prospector cannot read her Google Drive or resume library. V6 (2026-10-28) rebuilt it from Lisa's own update: full career history including earlier-career travel, retail and entrepreneurship, explicit commercial/sales-adjacent experience, client-industry exposure, the in-progress Adobe Digital Academy program, a role-interest hierarchy, and compensation/location priorities. Editing this file changes the cache fingerprint, so every one of Lisa's verdicts re-scores on the next run. KEEP adobe_digital_academy.status = 'in_progress' until Lisa confirms completion — the model is told to treat it exactly as stated here.
name: Lisa Hillier
current_title: Senior strategy, operations, transformation, professional-services, customer-experience and organizational leader
context_completeness: This profile is a summary, not her complete career. Absence of something here is NOT evidence she lacks it — classify it UNKNOWN, never as a gap.

demonstrated_outcomes: grew a global organization from ~28 to 54 people
led multidisciplinary teams across countries and time zones
enterprise client and executive stakeholder leadership

Leadership across digital experience, omnichannel campaigns, content/SEO, professional-services delivery and enterprise clients. Participated in discovery, solution development, scoping, RFP/pitch preparation and presentations.
Digital strategy, SEO/content and practice/operations leadership during growth and acquisition.

Reservation Sales & Support: direct reservation sales and customer service, domestic and international travel, specialized bookings, complex ticket reissues, partner/affiliate travel, fares, destinations and schedules, regulatory/policy requirements, needs identification; measured on customer satisfaction, quality and first-contact resolution. Airport Operations Administration / Station Finance & Audit Lead: station finance and audit, West-region responsibilities, finance/audit training, scheduling and payroll, operational process improvement, cross-functional airport operations; a process change cut SLC staffing costs by $250K+ in its first quarter with no reduction in force.
Marketing Communications Manager / Independent Travel Agent — independent travel-industry work plus marketing and customer-facing responsibilities.
Sales Support & Merchandising Manager — merchandising, retail operations, customer experience, sales support, people oversight.
Retail sales (incl. shoe department) — direct consumer sales, retail operations, customer service.
Owner / Designer — small-business ownership, entrepreneurship, customer relationships, weddings/events, service delivery, creative services, business operations.

career_history.employer: Oak Hills Dentistry / Glenn A. Zeh, DDS
career_history.scope: Dental-assisting education, internship and work experience.

how_to_weigh_history: Recent senior experience (2014 onward) establishes current SCOPE and SENIORITY. Earlier experience establishes INDUSTRY FAMILIARITY, customer-facing experience and breadth. Keep the two separate: older retail experience does not qualify her for a modern retail-merchandising executive role, and the floral/events business is evidence of entrepreneurship and service orientation, not of current senior qualifications.

direct: Travel and aviation (Delta Air Lines ~7 yrs; independent travel agent ~5 yrs). Travel, aviation, corporate travel and travel-tech are DIRECT industry experience — never describe travel as an industry she has not worked in.
Professional services / digital agencies / consulting (TA Digital, Credera, Omnicom, Axis41, Merkle, Dentsu, 180fusion)
Retail / consumer (Victoria's Secret, Macy's) — earlier-career familiarity, not modern executive merchandising expertise
Weddings / events / creative services (owned a business)
Nonprofit / workforce development (Women Tech Council / SheTech)
industry_experience.limited: Early dental-assisting experience establishes limited familiarity with a clinical/dental environment ONLY. It does NOT qualify her for clinical roles, licensed healthcare roles, or roles requiring substantive recent clinical experience.

commercial_and_sales_experience.summary: She is NOT 'without sales experience' — that statement is false. What she lacks is RECENT TRADITIONAL QUOTA-CARRYING SaaS ACCOUNT-EXECUTIVE CLOSING history. Keep those two things distinct in every judgment.
confirmed: working with sales and pre-sales teams
earlier direct consumer sales (Delta reservations sales; retail sales)
commercial_and_sales_experience.context: Her professional-services leadership required balancing what could be sold, staffed, delivered and delivered profitably.

adobe_digital_academy.how_to_use: IN PROGRESS, NOT COMPLETED. Never describe it as completed, certified or earned. It builds on her existing professional-services, solutioning, discovery, client and technology-consulting experience, and it SHOULD raise near-term readiness for consultative technical-sales roles (Solutions Consultant, Value Consultant and similar): such a role may be worth applying to NOW with the training disclosed as in progress, provided the employer imposes no hard requirement she cannot currently meet.

A_high_interest: AI adoption / AI enablement / business AI transformation
Customer success / value realization when strategic, consultative, transformation-oriented or enterprise-level
role_interest_hierarchy.C_note: C roles can still rank when compensation, company, strategic value, speed-to-income or scope make the opportunity unusually attractive.
D_generally_avoid: narrow specialist roles requiring deep domain expertise she does not have

not_her_work: technical product management requiring engineering depth
ai_interest.rule: AI in a title does not make a role relevant. Would she be BUILDING the technology, or leading its adoption? The second is her work.

technical_boundary.out_of_scope: Roles requiring HER PERSONALLY to have substantial expertise in software engineering, architecture or infrastructure, APIs or integrations, data engineering, ML/AI engineering, automation development, or technical implementation — regardless of title. Prospector also enforces this deterministically before scoring (screening.technical_screen).
technical_boundary.learnable: Technical knowledge that is LEARNABLE product/solution knowledge (as in consultative technical sales, demos, solution positioning) is NOT engineering depth and is not out of scope.

professional_services_stance: Highly relevant when the role is about practice/business operations, utilization, margin/profitability, resource/capacity planning, delivery health, operating cadence, org design, transformation, client value, service-line leadership, global delivery, process improvement, M&A integration or executive leadership. NOT when 'professional services' actually means deep hands-on product implementation or technical consulting requiring specialized engineering expertise.
customer_success_stance: Attractive when centred on strategic enterprise customers, value realization, transformation, executive relationships, adoption, operating-model improvement, complex customer programs, customer strategy, CX, or retention/expansion through realized value. Deprioritize high-volume account coverage, support-heavy CS, reactive escalation management, highly transactional renewals, and narrow product-support roles.
m_and_a_stance: Meaningful M&A INTEGRATION experience: post-merger integration, integration management, operating-model, organizational and people/process integration, transformation management, acquisition readiness, integration PMO, change/adoption around acquisitions. This is NOT corporate development: it does not qualify her for investment banking, valuation, financial-modeling-heavy corp dev, or transaction execution requiring specialized deal credentials.
recruiting_and_talent_stance: Judge recruiting/talent roles on duties, never title history. Recruiting operations, talent strategy, workforce planning, recruiting-process design, talent analytics, hiring-manager enablement and recruiting transformation are operating-model work. Flag the direct-execution gap where the posting genuinely requires full-cycle recruiting tenure, advanced sourcing, requisition ownership or offer negotiation, and name the specific skills to bridge.
seo_and_content: SEO / organic search / content strategy / content operations / GEO-AEO roles are B-tier interest on their own terms — do not require them to also describe transformation work.

compensation.permanent: Preferred ~$165K–$200K+; strong preference for $200K+ where fit supports it. Below ~$150K generally needs another compelling reason to rank highly.
compensation.contract_or_temporary: Willing to accept materially lower pay for credible near-term income; ~$85K annualized (or equivalent hourly) can be acceptable as a bridge. Do not reject an attractive contract because it misses long-term compensation goals.
compensation.unknown: When a posting states no pay, say so; do not guess and do not penalize it for silence.

practical_constraints.location_preference: Strong preference: (1) fully REMOTE within the US, or remote with reasonable travel; (2) UTAH local (Salt Lake / Silicon Slopes) hybrid or flexible; (3) hybrid/on-site in preferred relocation markets — Washington State, California, Oregon and the wider Western US are particularly relevant. Relocation can be considered for a sufficiently strong opportunity, so do not reject a strong role merely because it is not in Utah — reflect the cost in practical_fit instead. Washington DC is NOT Washington State.
practical_constraints.remote_eligibility: A location LABEL is not an eligibility statement. 'Remote - California' can mean a residence requirement, a pay zone, an associated office, a preference, or genuine nationwide US remote — read the posting and say which; answer 'unclear' rather than guessing.
practical_constraints.priority_employers: Adobe, Salesforce, Zillow Group, Atlassian, NPR, PBS, Marriott International and Hilton are deliberate targets. At Adobe she holds an employee referral, a recruiting contact and a Women Tech Council connection. That lifts opportunity_score (likelihood of response) and can justify a CONTACT action; it does NOT lift qualification or interest. A poorly matched role at Adobe is still a poorly matched role.
practical_constraints.employment_types: Open to permanent, contract, interim and temporary. Permanent career roles and fast-income contract roles are related but distinct lanes.

exceptional_opportunities: A role somewhat outside normal parameters may be surfaced for exceptional value: unusually high compensation, extraordinary mission/company alignment, exceptional career trajectory, a strong warm referral, a rare M&A/AI/transformation opportunity, a highly compelling sports/entertainment opportunity, an unusually strong sales-transition opportunity, or an unusually fast path to income. The exception must be named.
goals: Executive leadership in transformation and organizational scaling
M&A integration and enterprise AI adoption
A credible consultative technical-sales / solutions path alongside the primary search
